current_answer: Twelve listed ambassador routes have issuer-linked ways to apply and no published passed deadline: Hedera, Cyfrin, Soneium, Aster, Elk, Nomis, Torium, Nexo, Oasis Sentinels, Fiber, Bybit Africa Campus and HeLa. Bybit’s rolling route is for eligible university or college students in six named African countries; HeLa describes a six-month global program with token rewards, NFTs and perks rather than a fixed salary. Torium’s published $100–$250 per-post USDT thresholds begin at 50K verified views and require review. Pendulum offers Discord enrollment rather than a published application review; Wager Predict is not confirmed because its issuer post retains incomplete reward and region terms. Bitget’s campaign remains open through 30 Sep; MetaMask is not confirmed, Solana and SideShift are closed, and PIVX is referral-only.

catalogue_card.question: Two routes added; Torium’s $100 starts at 50K verified views
catalogue_card.text: Bybit opens a country-limited campus application and HeLa a global six-month program. Torium’s published $100 per-post reward starts at 50K verified views; key payment and workload terms still need checking.

summary: Bybit adds a rolling campus application for eligible university or college students in Ghana, South Africa, Kenya, Uganda, Ethiopia and Nigeria; individual reward amounts and hours are not stated.
HeLa adds a global Developer and Community Ambassador application with a six-month milestone term, token rewards, NFTs and perks rather than a fixed salary.
Torium’s stated USDT thresholds are $100 at 50K verified views, $150 at 100K and $250 at 200K per post, with review and wallet-payment conditions.
Pendulum is ongoing Discord enrollment, not a published application review; Wager Predict is held out because its issuer post retains incomplete reward and region terms.
Bitget’s distinct Trading Builder recruitment ends 30 Sep 2026; MetaMask is still not a confirmed public route, Solana and SideShift are closed, and PIVX is referral-only.
uncertainty: An issuer-linked route does not prove a hosted form will accept a submission or that an applicant will be selected.
Aster’s latest substantive issuer check is 14 Sep 2026 because its announcement did not render in later checks.
Bybit does not publish individual reward amounts, expected hours or its hosted-form fields; HeLa does not publish token value, redemption, workload or contract terms.
Torium’s stated payout thresholds, reviews and wallet payment route are issuer claims; no independent payout report was found.
Most listed routes do not publish decision-ready cash terms, hours, full selection rules or participant reports.
